rejected_recommendation.evidence_assessment: Partial support: The guidance evidence (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) supports the requirement for an orthogonal QC panel, fit-for-purpose validated intact-EV assays (LLOQ, specificity, precision), and stability-indicating, mechanism-linked potency assays prior to formulation advancement. The guidance does not supply program-specific manufacturing or biodistribution data; therefore program assertions about lacking MCB/WCB, batch reproducibility, or non-translatability are unsupported by the supplied evidence.
findings: MISEV2023 (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) explicitly recommends transparent, orthogonal characterization, appropriate controls, and validated intact-EV assays before asserting identity and potency claims for EV preparations.

No program-specific CMC/manufacturing records (MCB/WCB documentation, ≥3 GMP-like run reports with batch records and draft release specifications, or stability data) were provided to confirm reproducible production or scalability for SGL-001.

No program- or literature-supplied cross-species intranasal biodistribution data or orthogonal intact-EV recovery/identity assay data were provided to evaluate translatability from rodent to larger species or lot-to-lot reproducibility across species.
objections: The available evidence is limited to consensus guidance (MISEV2023) and does not provide any program-specific CMC, analytics, or cross-species biodistribution data; therefore assertions that the program lacks characterized MCB/WCB, reproducible GMP-like runs, or that rodent intranasal biodistribution will not translate to larger species remain unproven rather than contradicted.

claim_updates.rationale: MISEV2023 explicitly recommends these elements to de-risk identity and functional claims for EV preparations.
claim_updates.statement: Orthogonal characterization, validated intact-EV assays, and stability-indicating, mechanism-linked potency assays are necessary prior to advancing EV formulations or making identity/potency comparisons.

claim_updates.rationale: No program-specific MCB/WCB documentation or ≥3 GMP-like run reports with batch records and stability data were supplied to support this claim; MISEV2023 provides guidance but not program records.
claim_updates.statement: Program materials currently demonstrate characterized MCB/WCB and reproducible GMP-like runs sufficient to support formulation advancement.

claim_updates.rationale: No program- or literature-level cross-species intranasal biodistribution studies or orthogonal intact-EV recovery/identity assay data were provided to evaluate translatability or cross-species reproducibility.
claim_updates.statement: Rodent intranasal biodistribution findings do not translate to larger species and lot-to-lot reproducibility across species is lacking for SGL-001.

decision_update.question: What evidence-linked identity and potency framework is needed before comparing SGL-001 lots or formulations and advancing intranasal cross-species PK/PD testing?
decision_update.rationale: Stage-1 package must be supplied and reviewed to confirm MCB/WCB, batch reproducibility, validated orthogonal assays, and cross-species biodistribution before advancement. Current guidance supports the gate but program-specific data are missing.

proposed_changes.editorial_clarification: MISEV2023 is a consensus guidance document recommending best practices; it does not constitute program-specific evidence of manufacturing, batch reproducibility, or cross-species biodistribution.

hypothesis_update.rationale: MISEV2023 supports gating advancement on orthogonal characterization and validated assays to ensure observed biological differences reflect biology rather than product variability.
hypothesis_update.statement: Advancement to cross-species intranasal PK/PD testing should be gated on demonstration of reproducible product identity, potency, and intact-EV recovery across manufacturing lots and species.

proposed_changes.next_action: Assemble the Stage-1 package per the program plan and supply the missing evidence for review: (1) MCB/WCB documentation and provenance; (2) ≥3 GMP-like run reports with batch records, draft release specs, and stability data; (3) orthogonal QC assay descriptions and validation/fit-for-purpose reports (LLOQ, specificity, precision) including intact-EV recovery after formulation/device use; (4) stability-indicating, mechanism-linked potency assay development and correlation data to any in vivo PD endpoint; (5) primary biodistribution studies and any rodent-to-large-animal bridging data. If these do not exist, prioritize generation of MCB/WCB and orthogonal assay validation.

risk_updates.description: Lack of program-specific MCB/WCB documentation, validated orthogonal intact-EV assays, and GMP-like batch data risks misattribution of biological variability to product quality.
risk_updates.mitigation: Provide MCB/WCB documentation, ≥3 GMP-like run reports with batch records and stability data, and validated orthogonal intact-EV QC assays; withhold formulation advancement until demonstrated.
risk_updates.title: Insufficient CMC/analytics for identity and potency

risk_updates.description: No supplied rodent-to-large-animal bridging biodistribution data or intact-EV recovery analytics; translatability of rodent intranasal CNS exposure is therefore unproven.
risk_updates.mitigation: Generate primary biodistribution studies with rodent-to-large-animal bridging and demonstrate intact-EV recovery/identity across species using validated orthogonal assays prior to extrapolation.
risk_updates.title: Uncertain cross-species intranasal delivery/translatability

risk_updates.description: Without validated potency assays linked to mechanism and PD, preclinical efficacy signals may not predict clinical outcomes.
risk_updates.mitigation: Develop a stability-indicating, mechanism-linked potency assay and demonstrate correlation with an in vivo PD endpoint where possible.
risk_updates.title: Model-to-human efficacy generalizability risk

rejected_recommendation.recommendation: Do not advance comparative lot/formulation testing or cross-species intranasal PK/PD studies until a Stage-1 package is supplied and reviewed. Stage-1 must include: (1) MCB/WCB documentation and provenance; (2) ≥3 GMP-like run reports with batch records, draft release specifications, and stability data demonstrating reproducible yield/identity/potency; (3) orthogonal intact-EV QC assay descriptions and fit-for-purpose validation reports (LLOQ, specificity, precision) including intact-EV recovery after formulation/device use; (4) a stability-indicating, mechanism-linked potency assay with correlation to any available in vivo PD endpoint; (5) primary biodistribution studies and rodent-to-large-animal bridging data demonstrating reproducible intact-EV CNS exposure if available. Initiate prioritized generation of missing CMC and assay validation data if not available. This recommendation requires human approval and the decision remains pending.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: Unsupported: The MISEV guidance supports the requirement for documented, reproducible production (MCB/WCB, batch comparability) and transparent reporting, but the supplied evidence does not include any program-specific manufacturing records. Consequently, the assertion that current program materials do not demonstrate characterized source-cell MCB/WCB or scalable, reproducible production cannot be confirmed from the available evidence.
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: Missing program-specific CMC/manufacturing records (MCB/WCB documentation, GMP-like run reports for ≥3 batches, draft release specifications, and stability data) to confirm or refute production reproducibility and scalability.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: Unsupported / Conditional: MISEV2023 supports the general principle that orthogonal analytics and transparent production reporting are required to make credible intact-EV identity and potency claims and to interpret biodistribution data. However, the specific program claim that rodent intranasal biodistribution findings will not translate to larger species (or that lot-to-lot reproducibility across species is lacking) cannot be evaluated from the supplied materials because no program or literature-level cross-species intranasal biodistribution studies or orthogonal intact-EV recovery/identity assay data were provided.
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: No program- or literature-supplied cross-species intranasal biodistribution data or intact-EV orthogonal analytics were provided to assess translatability or lot-to-lot reproducibility across species.

verification_objections: claim-source-cell-scalability: The assertion that current program materials do not demonstrate characterized source-cell MCB/WCB or scalable, reproducible production sufficient to support advancing a specific intranasal formulation is unsupported by the cited evidence (MISEV2023) because that guidance does not contain program-specific manufacturing records or batch data.

claim-rodent-cns-delivery: The assertion that rodent intranasal biodistribution findings will not translate to larger species (or that lot-to-lot reproducibility across species is lacking) is unsupported by the cited evidence (MISEV2023); MISEV provides best-practice recommendations but does not supply program- or literature-level cross-species biodistribution or intact-EV recovery data to evaluate translatability.
